t: A very fast NXP chip that powers Teensy 4 boards for audio and music gadgets.
steps: Buy a Teensy 4.0 or Teensy 4.1 from SparkFun or another maker shop.
Get a micro-USB cable that carries data.
Install the free Arduino IDE on your computer.
Add the Teensy board package by following the Teensyduino install page.
Pick Teensy 4.0 or Teensy 4.1 in the board menu.
Upload the Blink example and watch the onboard light.
Try an example from the Teensy Audio Library to make your first sound.
